summary: Offline-first RTEC applicant intake/workflow application. Fillout feeds the Dashboard through the existing Google Sheets/Drive bridge; the Dashboard is now the canonical restricted normalization layer for a planned/live-validated Personal Agent OS connector.
current_priorities: Preserve the separation between ordinary hiring materials and restricted self-identification/Affirmative Action data, failing closed on source-schema drift.
Live-validate the new privacy-safe Fillout sync-health telemetry and append-only Agent OS event outbox on the work PC.
Expose only whitelisted administrative applicant DTOs through Personal Agent OS; never create a competing raw-Fillout applicant pipeline.
Keep Agent OS administrative/supportive: no applicant ranking, employment-outcome recommendations, or autonomous hiring/rejection decisions.
Keep all outbound applicant communications human-reviewed/user-directed.
Continue synthetic privacy/integration tests before substantial changes.
validation_commands: python -m py_compile process_applications.py dashboard_core.py rtec_dashboard.py screening_rules.py
constraints: Use synthetic data only for development and tests.
Never generically read/index applicant spreadsheets, PDFs, resumes, database rows, caches, drafts, sent email, backups, credentials, or restricted self-ID data.
Authorized applicant access is only through the explicit whitelisted local Agent OS adapter.
Never expose restricted self-ID data to ordinary recruiting tools or employment decisions.
Agent integrations may organize/summarize/status-track/schedule and prepare user-directed administrative drafts, but must not rank applicants or make employment decisions.
README.md and docs/AGENT_OS_INTEGRATION.md are current for runtime/integration behavior; historical setup documents are secondary references.
